text.short: Santa Barbara, on Victoria. Chef Dom Crisp cooks Basque against the Central Coast — seafood, cured meat, farm produce.
text.today: Dinner every night from five. Bar bites five to six daily, and late ones after nine Tuesday to Saturday. Book through OpenTable.
text.note: The marble bar came out of a decommissioned church and was put back together with kintsugi — the breaks gilded rather than hidden.

seating.note: A restaurant table or the bar; booked through OpenTable.
